did_you_know.text: Did you know? The chapter says that no one can stand against Leviathan, and immediately afterward emphasizes that everything under the heavens belongs to the Lord.
Did you know? Leviathan’s body is described as being covered with tightly fitted rows of overlapping shields, forming an impenetrable coat.
Did you know? Even around Leviathan’s mouth there is terror, and its teeth are described as part of its fearsome appearance.
Did you know? Leviathan’s sneezes are described as radiating light, and its eyes are compared to the eyelids of dawn.
Did you know? Torches and sparks of fire come from its mouth, while smoke rises from its nostrils like steam from a boiling pot.
Did you know? Leviathan’s heart is described as hard as stone—even as hard as the lower millstone.
Did you know? The chapter lists many weapons—sword, spear, armor, and arrows—and declares that none of them can harm Leviathan.
Did you know? Leviathan’s movement through the water is described as boiling the depths and churning the sea like a pot of broth.
Did you know? Leviathan leaves a shining trail in the water, making it seem as though the deep turns white with age.
Did you know? At the end of the description, it says that no creature on earth is like Leviathan, portraying it as fearless and as king over all the proud.
